title: ESENSC: A Polynomial-Time Axiomatic Alternative to SHAP
abstract: arXiv:2603.00496v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose ESENSC, a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded alternative to SHAP. ESENSC is a deterministic, closed-form attribution rule that requires only linearly many coalition-value evaluations, satisfies the null-player property, and admits an axiomatic characterization based on efficiency, a restricted form of differential marginality, and explicit computational constraints.Empirically, on tabular prediction tasks using neural network and XGBoost models, ESENSC shows close agreement with exact SHAP in both attribution magnitude and feature rankings while requiring substantially less computation. Under the evaluated settings, it compares favorably with widely used sampling-based SHAP approximations. While exact SHAP requires exponentially many coalition evaluations, ESENSC scales linearly with the number of features. These results show that ESENSC offers a favorable trade-off between agreement with exact SHAP

translated_title: ESENSC：SHAP的一种多项式时间公理化替代方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ESENSC，一种计算高效且具有理论基础SHAP替代方法。ESENSC是一种确定性的、闭式解析的归因规则，只需线性次数的联盟值评估，满足空玩家性质，并基于效率公理、受限形式的差分边际性以及明确的计算约束，获得了公理化刻画。在实证方面，在使用神经网络和XGBoost模型的表格预测任务上，ESENSC在归因大小和特征排序上均与精确SHAP高度一致，同时所需计算量大幅减少。在所评估的设置下，其表现优于广泛使用的基于采样的SHAP近似方法。精确SHAP需要指数次联盟评估，而ESENSC的计算量随特征数量呈线性扩展。这些结果表明，ESENSC在与精确SHAP的一致性和计算效率之间实现了良好的权衡。
tldr: ESENSC是一种仅需线性次联盟值评估的多项式时间确定性归因方法，在表格预测任务上与精确SHAP高度一致，同时计算成本远低于后者。
en_tdlr: ESENSC is a deterministic, polynomial-time attribution method requiring only linearly many coalition-value evaluations that closely matches exact SHAP on tabular prediction tasks at a fraction of the computational cost.
